description: Control Resonant's physical release has been delayed. Developer Remedy Entertainment announced Tuesday that the game had gone gold but its physical edition had been pushed back to October 15, 2026, three weeks after the game's digital release.
title: Control Resonant's Physical Release Delayed to October as Game Goes Gold

description: The 12GB RAM + 256GB storage variant of the Galaxy S25 now costs Rs. 84,999, instead of the launch price of Rs. 8,000. Similarly, the 12GB + 512GB storage variant of the Galaxy S25 is priced at Rs. 1,04,999, up from the launch price of Rs. 92,999. Samsung is not the only brand to hike smartphone prices in India. Recently, many Chinese smartphone brands have also hiked prices of their flagship and mid-range devices in India.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Price Hiked in India by Up to Rs. 12,000: Here’s How Much It Costs Now

description: Bybit says its security systems prevented more than $700 million (roughly Rs. 6,699 crore) in potential losses during the first half of 2026. The exchange blocked over 30,000 suspicious withdrawals and identified around $212 million (roughly Rs. 2,029 crore) in potentially fraudulent funds. The measures follow the $1.46 billion (roughly Rs. 13,978 crore) hack suffered by Bybit in February 2025, which prompted the exchange to strengthen its blockchain monitoring and AI-assisted security systems.
title: Bybit Says It Prevented Over $700 Million in Losses After $1.46 Billion Hack

description: Telegram has applied to ICANN for the .gram top-level domain, potentially opening up personalised web addresses for its users. If approved, usernames could become second-level domains such as yourname.gram, with Telegram also considering hosted interactive websites created through a single prompt. The application must pass ICANN's technical, financial and review processes before the domain can become active. The move could give Telegram greater control over its web infrastructure, particularly after its t.me links were temporarily disrupted earlier this year.
title: Telegram Users Could Get Personalised .gram Domains if ICANN Approves

description: PlayStation will launch its Pulse Elevate wireless speakers on November 12, 2026, with pre-orders opening in September. The speakers use planar magnetic drivers and built-in woofers, and include a microphone with AI-enhanced noise rejection for voice chat. PlayStation Link provides low-latency, lossless audio, while Bluetooth enables connections to other devices. A rechargeable battery supports portable use with PlayStation Portal and smartphones. The speakers will be sold in Midnight Black and White, with regional pricing varying across markets.
title: PlayStation Pulse Elevate Wireless Speakers Price, Features Revealed Ahead of November 12 Launch

description: Nexo Australia has launched cryptocurrency-backed credit lines after receiving credit representative authorisation under Australia’s consumer credit framework. Eligible customers can borrow Australian dollars or stablecoins against their digital assets, with advertised annual interest rates ranging from 0.9 percent to 21.9 percent. The products are provided through licensed credit provider Avgi Pty Ltd, while Nexo Australia handles applications, account management and customer support. Borrowers can retain their crypto holdings while accessing liquidity.
title: Nexo Australia Begins Offering Credit Lines Against Cryptocurrency Collateral

description: Leaked details suggest Vivo could give OriginOS 7 a broader visual refresh alongside more flexible system controls. The upcoming software may introduce three glass-based interface treatments and let users disable the effects entirely. A new translucent dock, updated animations and expanded Control Centre editing are also reportedly in development. Users could rearrange or remove connectivity, media and other control modules, while the lower shortcut area may become editable. Vivo has started beta recruitment for the Android 17-based software as testing continues.
title: Vivo's Android-17 Based OriginOS 7 Could Get Liquid Glass UI and More Customisation Options

description: Vivo recently hiked the prices of five Y-series smartphones in India, and the company has now carried out a similar price increase for one of the models in its T-lineup. According to a tipster, the Vivo T5 Pro 5G has become more expensive in the country across all the RAM and storage configurations. While the company has yet to officially communicate the price revision, the tipster claims a few other Vivo models could also see a price hike beginning next week.
title: Vivo T5 Pro 5G Gets Another Price Hike, Now Up to Rs. 30,000 More Expensive Than at Launch

description: Poco F9 Ultra's design has been spotted in a leaked diagram. The upcoming handset is shown to sport a flat touchscreen, featuring a centred hole-punch display cutout at the top, which might house a camera for selfies and video calls. It might also boast relatively thin bezels. The power button and volume controls will reportedly be placed on the right side of the phone. A leaker claims that the Poco F9 Ultra will be launched in select global markets with a price tag of EUR 1,199 (roughly Rs. 1,33,000) for the variant featuring 16GB of RAM and 512GB of internal storage.
title: Poco F9 Ultra Appears in Leaked Diagram; Tipped to Be More Expensive Than Earlier Anticipated

description: Maya Protocol has halted its MAYAChain network after an exploit allowed an attacker to manipulate a liquidity pool and withdraw Bitcoin and other crypto assets. The protocol said six software bugs were required to execute the attack, which created a false balance of nearly 49 million CACAO in a pool that held only 168,000 CACAO. The attacker later converted the manipulated tokens into Bitcoin and Ether, while Maya Protocol works on recovery and remediation.
title: Maya Protocol Loses $11 Million in Pool Value After Exploit Drains Bitcoin and Other Assets

description: Google has clarified the fallback behaviour of Gboard Rambler after users reach its usage cap. The Gemini-powered voice input feature continues processing speech through its offline mode, retaining filler-word removal, punctuation, capitalisation and basic cleanup. More advanced tools, including stylistic rewrites, tone changes, text shortening and complex conversational edits, need an internet connection. Rambler is currently available on Pixel 11 series devices and supports several languages, including English and Hindi. Users can also switch to Google's standard voice typing option.
title: Google Says Gboard Rambler Switches to Offline Mode After Usage Limit: Report

description: A tipster has claimed once again that the OnePlus 16 will come with a 165Hz refresh rate display. It is said to debut with BOE's next-generation oriental screen. It could ship with ColorOS 17. The OnePlus 16 is rumoured to run on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset. It could feature a 200-megapixel telephoto camera and a 9,000mAh battery.
title: OnePlus 16 Display Details Again Leaked Online; Tipped to Feature ColorOS 17

description: Poco M8x 5G will be available for purchase in India in three colour options, namely Black, Blue, and Leather Green, with the green shade boasting a “vegan leather finish”, the tech firm revealed on Wednesday. Moreover, the Poco M8x 5G is confirmed to launch in India with Xiaomi’s HyperOS 3, which is based on Android 16. The Xiaomi sub-brand promises that the phone will receive four OS upgrades and six years of security updates. The display of the upcoming handset will offer Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection and Wet Touch 2.0. The Poco M8x 5G will also ship with an IP64 rating for dust and splash resistance.
title: Poco M8x 5G Colour Options, Durability Details and More Announced Ahead of India Launch

description: WhatsApp is said to be working on a new AI-powered photo expansion feature in the drawing editor that will allow users to expand a photo to the 9:16 format using Meta AI. The feature was reportedly spotted in the WhatsApp beta for Android 2.26.33.2.  The expansion tool could be available in the drawing editor. To expand a photo, users will need to open it in the drawing editor, and then Meta AI will analyse the image and generate additional content around its edges.
title: WhatsApp Could Soon Let You Expand Photos to 9:16 Format on Android Using Meta AI
Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8: The Lightest Foldable Built Like a Powerhouse

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay seems to have leaked ahead of the game's planned Netflix premiere. The leaked footage shows driving, combat, and other activities from the game. A group called Cyberleek has taken responsibility for the GTA 6 gameplay leak and said that it had targeted Rockstar Games and Take-Two over the lack of physical disc version of the game and the publisher's approach towards single-player DLC and content.
title: GTA 6 Suffers Major Leak Showing Gameplay Ahead of Planned Extended Look on Netflix

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra design has been spotted in purported official-looking renders of the upcoming tablet. The tablet appears in a grey colourway. It is shown to sport a flat rear panel, with a horizontally aligned dual rear camera system placed in the top-right corner of the panel. An LED flash could also be placed next to the camera module. Meanwhile, the horizontally-aligned Samsung branding is expected to be placed in the top-left corner of the panel. On top of this, the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra is shown to be equipped with a flat display, similar to its predecessor. Moreover, the company is expected to equip its flagship tablet with a waterdrop-style notch, which might house a camera for selfies and video calls.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra Design Spotted in Official-Looking Leaked Renders

description: Redmi M100 has been launched in China. The new Redmi phone comes in three colour options and has a 6.9-inch display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate. It runs on the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 mobile platform and carries a 7,900mAh cell that supports 45W wired and 22.5W reverse wired charging. It is currently available for purchase in China with a starting price tag of CNY 1,999 (roughly Rs. 28,000).
title: Redmi M100 Launched With 7,900mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: The iQOO Z11S has arrived in China with a 10,000mAh battery, 44W charging and a 6.83-inch AMOLED screen offering a 144Hz refresh rate. The phone uses a Dimensity 7500 Full-Power Version chipset and comes with up to 12GB RAM and 512GB storage. Its camera setup includes a 50-megapixel rear sensor and an 8-megapixel selfie camera. Other features include OriginOS 6, Android 16, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC and IP68 and IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance.
title: iQOO Z11S Launched With 10,000mAh Battery, 144Hz AMOLED Display: Price, Features

description: Bitcoin recovered as buyers returned to the market, with institutional demand improving despite weak spot and on-chain activity. The cryptocurrency continues to face resistance at higher levels, while elevated Treasury yields and geopolitical risks could limit further gains.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds as $297.6 Million Flows Into US Spot ETFs

description: The Realme 17 series has been the subject of rumours lately, with leaks revealing camera specifications of the Realme 17 Pro+ earlier this year. The purported handset, which is expected to headline the brand’s numbered lineup, is once again in the news. A tipster has now shed light on the display and more camera features of the Realme 17 Pro+. It is tipped to arrive with a flat OLED display, alongside a 200-megapixel camera setup.
title: Realme 17 Pro+ Tipped to Get 200-Megapixel Camera; Display Details Surface Online

description: The Realme P4s 5G will be launched in India next week, the company announced on Wednesday. The upcoming handset will arrive as the latest addition to the brand’s new P-series lineup, which already comprises the Realme P4, Realme P4 Lite, Realme P4x, and Realme P4 Pro 5G models. The company has also revealed key specifications ahead of its anticipated debut. It will feature a Dimensity 7400 Ultra chipset and pack an 8,000mAh battery.
title: Realme P4s 5G India Launch Date Announced; Key Specifications Revealed

description: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra launched in China with a 9,100mAh battery and support for 100W fast charging. The iQOO Neo 11 Ultra runs on an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 9500M chipset, paired with up to 16GB RAM and up to 512GB onboard storage. It has a 2K resolution display and a 50-megapixel rear camera unit. This model is IP68 and IP69-rated for dust and water resistance.
title: iQOO Neo 11 Ultra Launched With Dimensity 9500M Chip, 9,100mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has been spotted in a “Sales Regulation” (translated from Polish) document on the Samsung Poland website. The document lists seven Galaxy S26 FE versions, with the model numbers SM-S741BLGDEUE, SM-S741BLGGEUE, SM-S741BZKDEUE, SM-S741BZKGEUE, SM-S741BZKIEUE, SM-S741BZVDEUE, and SM-S741BZVGEUE. This comes shortly after the purported renders of the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE surfaced online, revealing the upcoming ‘Fan Edition’ model’s design and colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Spotted in Official Document With Seven Model Numbers

description: Apple's newly granted patent describes a pressure-sensitive physical control that could be used on a future tablet. The mechanism can detect different levels of force, determine where pressure is applied and respond with haptic feedback. It can also support swipe gestures, making it comparable to the Camera Control on recent iPhone models. The patent includes tablet-focused illustrations and follows an earlier filing from December 2025. Apple has not confirmed whether the technology will be used on an iPad or any other upcoming device.
title: Apple May Add Camera Control Button to Future iPad, Patent Reveals

description: Apple will launch the first mobile chipset fabricated using TSMC's 2nm process, according to a tipster citing supply chain sources. The company is expected to launch the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra, which are expected to be powered by the A20 Pro chipset, which could be built on TSMC's 2nm process. The leaker also claims that the iPhone 18 Pro’s A20 Pro chipset will deliver significantly better performance than last year’s A19 Pro SoC, which powers the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max. According to the tipster, the chipset will provide an 18 percent performance enhancement, along with a power consumption reduction of about 30 percent. However, this is said to increase the procurement costs for the company “significantly”.
title: iPhone 18 Pro’s A20 Pro Chip Could Be Apple’s First SoC Built on TSMC’s 2nm Process, Tipped to Deliver Major Performance Gains

description: Samsung's August 2026 SMR now seems to be reaching more Galaxy devices. It was first released for the Galaxy Watch 5 Pro, followed by the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series and several other Galaxy handsets. Samsung seems to be rolling out the update to devices in South Korea. It is expected to reach more devices soon.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and More Get August 2026 Security Patch: Report

description: Krafton on Tuesday announced that pre-registrations for Battlegrounds Mobile India Lite (BGMI Lite) in India will begin next week. The developer says only Android users in the country will initially be able to pre-register for the game via the Google Play Store. The upcoming addition to the Battlegrounds Mobile India franchise is expected to be aimed at the popular online battle royale experience accessible to a wider range of smartphones, including affordable, low-end models.
title: BGMI Lite Pre-Registration Date in India Announced Ahead of Late 2026 Launch

description: The iPhone 18 series is expected to be just a couple of months away, and leaks about Apple’s next-generation smartphones are now surfacing rapidly. For months now, it has been rumoured that the iPhone 18 Pro models could bring about a major camera upgrade, thanks to the introduction of variable aperture technology. A tipster, however, now claims that only one of the models may be equipped with a variable aperture camera. It may feature sensor upgrades, too.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max May Be the Only Model to Get Variable Aperture Camera, Tipster Claims
